trap.label: ativa × passiva (presente)
trap.wrong: Letters sort by machines. It delivered by the postman every day.
trap.right: Letters are sorted by machines. It is delivered by the postman every day.
trap.why: Em português “as cartas são separadas” ou “separam-se cartas” são frequentes. O brasileiro traduz sem be. Em inglês, active: sujeito faz; passive: am/is/are + pp.

mcq.q: Active: The postman delivers it. Passive: It ___ by the postman.

fix.right: The mail is carried by trucks.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “Machines sort the letters.”
rewrite.answer: The letters are sorted by machines.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a ativa: “Parcels are weighed by workers.”
Torne negativa a passiva: “It is delivered on Sundays.”
